Project Objectives
The following are the Finalized objectives of the project:1. To develop a BLE-based mobile communication backbone for transmitting real-time patient vitals to a mobile application, which securely forwards data to the cloud using MQTT over TLS, with CoAP as a backup.2. To integrate the existing patient health monitoring system with the mobile communication backbone for continuous vital acquisition, transmission, and remote monitoring during ambulance transit.3. To implement RTOS-based concurrent task management for sensor acquisition, vital processing, communication, and local display, ensuring responsive and reliable operation.4. To develop an ML-based patient risk prediction module that analyses real-time vitals, identifies potential deterioration, and classifies patient risk levels for early clinical assessment.
